scope: Complete Lantern popup2 pages:30 active-when-page-selected TMP fields in5 six-layer groups,12 inactive Swim Floaties title fields preserved. Owner supplies both pages and an older PurpleBell overlap already covered by pending shared heading repair.
context: Approved Lantern Jar tfol113 inventory full term Банка-фонарь; popup source abbreviates Lantern, and accepted ornamental heading g035/g046 uses ФОНАРЬ. Item remains jar of Fireflies tfol112; Sweater tfol086 and Swim Floaties tfol077 approved. Player Rascal/Плут male red panda, лапы context supported. Preserve darkest/deepest woods/world exploration, automatic use like both other accessories, no Dodge-Roll WHILE HOLDING (not merely owning), humorous firefly reluctance. перекат is evasive roll; do not add controls or conditions. Source bareCR in page1 normalized toLF, page2 paragraph gaps preserved, caption parentheses and title size22 initial preserved. All30 fields and full42 source family considered; no unrelated inactive title translation, native or release acceptance.

rows.source:
Now you can explore the darkest depths of the world!

Much like the Sweater, or the Swimfloaties, this will activate automatically.


Be careful though, you can't Dodge-Roll while holding this. The Fireflies wouldn't appreciate it...
rows.target:
Теперь можно исследовать самые тёмные уголки мира!

Фонарь используется автоматически — как свитер и надувные нарукавники.


Но с фонарём в лапах нельзя делать перекаты. Светлячки такого не оценят...

rows.source:
